variants.title: RS latch of two NAND gates
variants.method: two cross-coupled NAND gates with active-low inputs
variants.unknown: the characteristic table of the RS latch
variants.sample: SN7400 quad 2-input NAND, two gates used

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, flip-flops from NAND gates

variants.title: Gated D latch from five NAND gates
variants.method: a clocked RS latch with R = NOT D
variants.unknown: the characteristic table of the D latch
variants.sample: SN7400 quad 2-input NAND, five gates used

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, flip-flops from NAND gates

variants.title: Level-triggered JK flip-flop from NAND gates (race-around)
variants.method: a clocked RS latch with feedback from Q and Q-bar
variants.unknown: the characteristic table of the JK flip-flop and its race-around
variants.note: With J = K = 1 the level-triggered circuit flips over and over while the clock is HIGH.

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, flip-flops from NAND gates
